summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and finished-time capture in rich/progress.py, added Palette.__rich__ in rich/palette.py, added the progress.elapsed default style (yellow), a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, a TimeElapsedColumn unit test and column-list entry with a hand-traced regenerated expected string in tests/test_progress.py, and a new tests/test_palette.py. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so test results are unverified; the test_columns expected output is derived from a manual clock-read trace and is the most likely point of mismatch.
